# Mongolia: effects used by the focus tree (common/national_focus/mdr_mongolia.txt, generated by
# herramientas/make_mongolia.py) and its monthly checks.

# From on_monthly (MON only): the dzud of 1999-2002 at the start, the dzud of 2010, integration of claimed states.
mdr_mon_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = mdr_mon_started }
			date < 2001.6.1
		}
		set_country_flag = mdr_mon_started
		add_timed_idea = { idea = mdr_mon_dzud days = 540 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = mdr_mon_dzud_2010_done }
			date > 2010.1.1
			date < 2010.4.1
			NOT = { has_completed_focus = mdr_mon_S7 }
		}
		mdr_mon_dzud_2010 = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdr_mon_integrate }
		every_owned_state = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { is_core_of = ROOT }
				OR = { state = 556 state = 1097 state = 1011 state = 686 }
			}
			add_to_variable = { mdr_mon_integration_months = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { mdr_mon_integration_months > 23 }
					ROOT = { has_stability > 0.5 }
				}
				add_core_of = ROOT
			}
		}
	}
}

# S1: halves the start-of-game dzud.
mdr_mon_dzud_relief = {
	if = { limit = { has_idea = mdr_mon_dzud }
		remove_ideas = mdr_mon_dzud
		add_timed_idea = { idea = mdr_mon_dzud_mild days = 270 }
	}
	add_political_power = -23
}

# S7 or the January 2010 check: the damage depends on fodder reserves and livestock insurance.
mdr_mon_dzud_2010 = {
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdr_mon_dzud_2010_done } }
	else = {
		set_country_flag = mdr_mon_dzud_2010_done
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = mdr_mon_fodder_reserves
				has_country_flag = mdr_mon_livestock_insurance
			}
			add_timed_idea = { idea = mdr_mon_dzud_mild days = 180 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = mdr_mon_fodder_reserves }
			add_timed_idea = { idea = mdr_mon_dzud_mild days = 360 }
		}
		else = {
			add_timed_idea = { idea = mdr_mon_dzud days = 540 }
		}
		country_event = { id = mdr_mon.2 }
	}
}

# S4: cropland where the steppe allows it (Realpolitik cropland needs arable soil, mdr_arable_land).
mdr_mon_steppe_wells = {
	every_owned_state = {
		limit = {
			OR = { state = 596 state = 597 }
			mdr_arable_land > 0
		}
		add_building_construction = { type = mdr_cropland level = 1 instant_build = yes }
	}
	add_stability = 0.02
}

# S12: trees against desertification lower pollution (mdr_climate.txt).
mdr_mon_green_wall = {
	every_owned_state = {
		limit = { OR = { state = 596 state = 597 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = mdr_pollution }
			subtract_from_variable = { mdr_pollution = 7 }
			clamp_variable = { var = mdr_pollution min = 0 max = 100 }
		}
	}
}

# X2: recognised nuclear-weapon-free status; joins the NPT if it was outside (mdr_treaties.txt).
mdr_mon_nuclear_free = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { OR = { original_tag = USA original_tag = SOV original_tag = CHI original_tag = ENG original_tag = FRA } }
		add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = mdr_mon_rel_15 }
	}
	add_political_power = 29
}

# P8B: media one level closer to state control.
mdr_mon_media_step_up = {
	if = { limit = { has_variable = mdr_media_level }
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_media_target = mdr_media_level }
		add_to_temp_variable = { mdr_media_target = 1 }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = mdr_media_target min = 1 max = 5 }
		mdr_media_set_level = yes
	}
}

# P8C: surveillance one level up.
mdr_mon_surveillance_step_up = {
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_civil_target = 2 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = mdr_surveillance_level }
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_civil_target = mdr_surveillance_level }
		add_to_temp_variable = { mdr_civil_target = 1 }
	}
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = mdr_civil_target min = 1 max = 4 }
	mdr_surveillance_set = yes
}

# E5A: Rio Tinto enters Oyu Tolgoi (mdr_mnc.txt), without the decision's cost.
mdr_mon_invite_rio_tinto = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mdr_mnc_riotinto > 0 } } }
		set_variable = { mdr_mnc_riotinto = 1 }
		set_variable = { mdr_mnc_riotinto_frz = 0 }
		set_country_flag = { flag = mdr_mnc_riotinto_new days = 1095 value = 1 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.mdr_mnc_riotinto_h value = THIS } } }
			add_to_array = { global.mdr_mnc_riotinto_h = THIS }
		}
	}
}

# E6A: the 2009 investment agreement takes Rio Tinto to level 3.
mdr_mon_rio_tinto_deal = {
	mdr_mon_invite_rio_tinto = yes
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mnc_riotinto < 3 } }
		set_variable = { mdr_mnc_riotinto = 3 }
	}
}

# P10C: every foreign company here is nationalized at once (same result as the mdr_mnc_nat_* decisions).
mdr_mon_seize_mines = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mnc_riotinto > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_mnc_riotinto_nat = mdr_mnc_riotinto }
		set_variable = { mdr_mnc_riotinto = 0 }
		set_country_flag = { flag = mdr_mnc_riotinto_out days = 3650 value = 1 }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = ENG }
			ENG = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = mdr_mnc_expropriated } }
		}
		add_timed_idea = { idea = mdr_mnc_expropriation_risk days = 1825 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = 0.11 }
	modify_treasury_effect = yes
}

# G3, G6, G8: money for the Mongol movement in a neighbouring state; at war or in a civil war, a rising.
mdr_mon_fund_separatists = {
	$STATE$ = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { is_owned_by = ROOT }
				owner = { OR = { has_civil_war = yes has_war = yes } }
			}
			add_resistance = 17
		}
	}
	add_political_power = -17
}

# G14: rails to the new states.
mdr_mon_khanate_railway = {
	every_owned_state = {
		limit = { OR = { state = 556 state = 1097 state = 1011 state = 686 } }
		add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 2 instant_build = yes }
	}
}

# G15: the Great Khanate (cosmetic tag MDR_MON_KHANATE, flags in gfx/flags).
mdr_mon_proclaim_khanate = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = mdr_mon_khanate_tt
	set_cosmetic_tag = MDR_MON_KHANATE
	# A Great Khan replaces the head of state, in the ruling party's group so he leads the government.
	hidden_effect = {
		kill_country_leader = yes
		if = { limit = { has_government = democratic }
			create_country_leader = { name = MDR_MON_GREAT_KHAN desc = MDR_MON_GREAT_KHAN_desc picture = "mdr_great_khan.dds" ideology = Western_Autocracy traits = { western_Western_Autocracy mdr_mon_great_khan } }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { has_government = communism }
			create_country_leader = { name = MDR_MON_GREAT_KHAN desc = MDR_MON_GREAT_KHAN_desc picture = "mdr_great_khan.dds" ideology = Autocracy traits = { emerging_Autocracy mdr_mon_great_khan } }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { has_government = fascism }
			create_country_leader = { name = MDR_MON_GREAT_KHAN desc = MDR_MON_GREAT_KHAN_desc picture = "mdr_great_khan.dds" ideology = Kingdom traits = { salafist_Kingdom mdr_mon_great_khan } }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { has_government = neutrality }
			create_country_leader = { name = MDR_MON_GREAT_KHAN desc = MDR_MON_GREAT_KHAN_desc picture = "mdr_great_khan.dds" ideology = Neutral_Autocracy traits = { neutrality_Neutral_Autocracy mdr_mon_great_khan } }
		}
		else = {
			create_country_leader = { name = MDR_MON_GREAT_KHAN desc = MDR_MON_GREAT_KHAN_desc picture = "mdr_great_khan.dds" ideology = Monarchist traits = { nationalist_Monarchist mdr_mon_great_khan } }
		}
	}
	add_political_power = 50
	add_stability = 0.11
	news_event = { id = mdr_mon.4 }
}

# G16: the region takes fright.
mdr_mon_world_alarm = {
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				original_tag = JAP original_tag = KOR original_tag = KAZ original_tag = CHI original_tag = SOV
			}
		}
		add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = mdr_mon_rel_neg_25 }
	}
	add_political_power = 37
}
